lesson: Default-scale inclusion (0.6-1.4) at 30/10/10 is the best recipe: it extended mAP50 to 0.6614 with the best scratches (0.757) and competitive inclusion (0.490), beating the small-inclusion variant. Pushing inclusion to 40 (candidate 2) backfired — inclusion AP50 fell to 0.410 and mAP50 dropped, so 30 is the sweet spot and 5/5 starvation of the other classes is not worth it. Small patches (candidate 3) recovered patches (0.800) but cost inclusion and scratches, a net loss; the default recipe is the final bet.
